clue.text: Subtle suggestions in what could be seen as rude sonnet

indicators.note: the clue asks what the two words could be seen as once their letters are rearranged into another phrase

explanation.surface: A critic detects hints of innuendo in a sonnet that might strike some readers as crude.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: faint underlying tones or implications behind what is said are subtle suggestions.

clue.text: Cancel social gathering of many nations' representatives?

parts.note: the United Nations, abbreviated UN, gathers representatives of many nations
a do is an informal word for a party or social event

explanation.surface: Calling off a party held for delegates of the United Nations.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to reverse or annul an action is to cancel it.

clue.text: Report of comic hero, one growing wild?

indicators.note: a report is something heard, so the clue's phrase is to be taken as it sounds when spoken

parts.note: a 'dandy lion' - Dandy and Lion were both British children's comics, and a lion is a heroic figure

explanation.surface: A news item about a cartoon superhero who has gone feral.
explanation.walkthrough: Spoken, 'dandy lion' matches the name of the weed; The Dandy and Lion were well-known British weekly comics.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the yellow-flowered plant is a common weed that springs up uncultivated in lawns and verges.

clue.text: See love — offered by him?

parts.note: the Holy See, the seat of the Pope, is in Rome
love is zero in tennis scoring, written as the letter O

explanation.surface: An invitation to witness the devotion a famous lover would show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' looks like a verb but is the noun for a bishop's seat; the whole clue also describes Shakespeare's lover offering devotion to Juliet.
explanation.definitionFit: Allusion: Shakespeare's young lover of Juliet is the archetype of a man who offers devotion.

clue.text: Coppers in out-of-date account

parts.note: something old is out of date
a bill is an account of money owed

explanation.surface: Police officers mentioned in an outdated report.
explanation.walkthrough: The Old Bill is British slang for the police.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang: British informal name for the police force collectively, as coppers are policemen.

clue.text: Unsettled wanderers — we going off for business trips?

indicators.note: unsettled letters are disturbed and rearranged into a new order
going off means the two letters of the little word leave the longer word

explanation.surface: Restless nomads leave, and we depart on trips for work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going off' removes W and E from WANDERERS, leaving ANDRERS; 'Unsettled' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: short journeys made to deliver or collect something on someone's behalf are trips on business.

clue.text: To sleep rough in rubbish? Not right!

indicators.note: not right says the abbreviation for right, the letter R, is taken out

parts.note: dross is waste or rubbish

explanation.surface: Bedding down outdoors among the refuse is plainly wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang: to bed down in a makeshift or outdoor place is to sleep rough.

clue.text: Frequently become more mellow, having lost head

indicators.note: having lost its head means the first letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: to soften is to become more mellow or gentle

explanation.surface: Someone who often grows calmer, as if losing their temper less.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: happening many times or regularly means frequently.

clue.text: Ten secrets about what actor may have to go through

definitions.text: what actor may have to go through

indicators.note: about signals the letters being turned around and reshuffled into a new order

explanation.surface: A list of ten confidential matters concerning a performer's ordeal.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: a filmed audition to judge suitability for a role is a trial an actor may face.

clue.text: Material your setter's kept at back of study

indicators.note: kept at the back of means the second piece is placed after the first

parts.note: a den is a private study or room
the setter speaking in the first person: I'm, setter's meaning setter is

explanation.surface: The compiler confesses to lurking at the back of a library.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: hard-wearing cotton twill used for jeans is a fabric, a material.

clue.text: Bodily tissue at a murder looking dreadful

indicators.note: looking dreadful suggests the letters are in a terrible state, rearranged

explanation.surface: Body tissue at a crime scene looks horrific.
explanation.walkthrough: The dura mater is the tough outer membrane around the brain and spinal cord.
explanation.definitionFit: Anatomy: the tough outermost membrane enclosing the brain is a kind of tissue in the body.

clue.text: Engineer relaxing in Minorca

indicators.note: relaxing suggests loosening the letters so they fall into a new order

explanation.surface: An engineer unwinding on holiday on a Spanish island.
explanation.walkthrough: Guglielmo Marconi was the Italian engineer who pioneered radio.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Italian pioneer of wireless telegraphy was an electrical engineer.

clue.text: English fashion set by boy who has private education?

indicators.note: set by means the boy's name is placed beside, after, the earlier pieces

parts.note: ton is an old word for the height of fashion
Ian is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A trend in England started by a privately schooled lad.
explanation.walkthrough: Eton is a famous English private boarding school.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a pupil or former pupil of Eton College has been privately educated.

clue.text: Indian princess managed extremes of elegance

parts.note: to run something is to manage it, so ran means managed

indicators.note: extremes are the first and last letters of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A royal lady from India who carried herself with great elegance.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a rani or ranee is the wife of a rajah or a Hindu queen or princess.

clue.text: Gregory is seen to be so self-centred

definitions.text: Gregory is seen to be so self-centred

parts.words: Gregory is seen to be so self-centred
parts.note: the letters E, G and O, a word for the self, sit right in the middle of the name Gregory, so the name has the self at its centre

explanation.surface: A remark that a man named Gregory comes across as vain.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as EGO + CENTRIC: the name G-R-E-G-O-R-Y has EGO at its centre.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: concerned chiefly with oneself means self-centred.

clue.text: Flying uni flag could be worthwhile

indicators.note: flying letters are sent through the air and land in a new order

explanation.surface: Hoisting the university banner might prove profitable.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: profitable or productive activity is worthwhile.

clue.text: Female puts down plants for decoration maybe

parts.note: to lower something is to put it down

explanation.surface: A woman sets down pots of greenery to brighten a room.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: blooms are plants often arranged to decorate a room or table.

clue.text: Try to get place in athletics event

parts.note: a shot is an attempt or try
to put is to place

explanation.surface: An athlete trying to qualify for a spot in a competition.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: hurling a heavy metal ball for distance is a field event in track and field.

clue.text: TV — top aria may be rendered by this tenor

indicators.note: rendered means made into something else, so the letters are reworked into a name

explanation.surface: A television hit song performed by a famous singer.
explanation.walkthrough: Luciano Pavarotti was the celebrated Italian operatic tenor.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Italian opera star famed for Nessun Dorma was a tenor.

clue.text: What avoids circumlocution — and is needed in tribunal, no end

indicators.note: the word and is needed inside, so it goes within the shortened court
no end means the last letter of the word is cut off

parts.note: a court is a tribunal of justice

explanation.surface: Plain speaking, essential in a court that never adjourns.
explanation.walkthrough: The dash makes 'What avoids circumlocution' look like a question; it is the definition, frankness being the opposite of beating about the bush.
explanation.definitionFit: Description: frankness, saying things directly, is the opposite of talking round a subject.

clue.text: Book put to one side

definitions.meaning: to book is to arrange in advance, as a table or seat
to set aside or keep back for later use

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses of one verb: making a booking, and keeping something back for later.

clue.text: Time to go to busy places to catch European criminals

indicators.note: to catch means to hold within, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: a hive is a busy place, as in a hive of activity

explanation.surface: Police head for crowded places to arrest crooks from Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: those who steal property are a kind of criminal.

clue.text: Ironed shirt finally sorted out and tested for size?

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word before it
sorted out means the letters are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A pressed shirt, at last ready, is put on to check the fit.
explanation.definitionFit: Phrasal verb: putting on clothes to see if they fit means they were tested for size.

clue.text: Explosive container brought around by engineers

indicators.note: brought around means the word for a container is turned back to front

parts.note: a tin is a container
RE stands for the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps

explanation.surface: Army engineers carry a box of explosives into position.
explanation.walkthrough: Saltpetre, potassium nitrate, is an ingredient of gunpowder.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: saltpetre, potassium nitrate, is used in gunpowder and so counts as an explosive.

clue.text: Drops bombs

definitions.meaning: drops of liquid from the eyes when crying
to bomb along is to speed, to rush or race along

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: drops shed by weeping eyes, and the verb meaning rushes along at speed.

clue.text: Label for person who perseveres

definitions.meaning: someone who sticks at a task and does not give up

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: an adhesive tag, and one who sticks at things doggedly.

clue.text: Rogue's central part in place of worship, we hear

indicators.note: we hear means the word is identified by how it sounds when spoken

parts.words: central part in place of worship
parts.note: the nave is the central body of a church

explanation.surface: A scoundrel lurking in the main part of a church.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a dishonest or unscrupulous man is a rogue, a rascal.

clue.text: Doctor gets you improving finally — prescribing this?

definitions.text: Doctor gets you improving finally — prescribing this?

parts.note: U is text-speak for you

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: A physician gets the patient better at last by writing a prescription.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also describes the answer: what a doctor prescribes to help a patient recover.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a medicine a doctor writes a prescription for to make a patient better.

clue.text: Relieved from anxiety, being given a new policy?

definitions.meaning: having one's worries removed or comforted
the word read as ..., insured again, as with a fresh insurance policy

explanation.definitionFit: Two readings: comforted after worry, and fancifully assured afresh, given new insurance cover.

clue.text: Change some controversial terminology

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A call to replace some disputed jargon.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to modify or make different is to change.

clue.text: Bit of luggage for instance

definitions.meaning: a suitcase, an item of luggage
an example, as in a ... in point

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a suitcase carried when travelling, and an example or occurrence of something.

clue.text: Purpose of French band taking circuitous route

parts.note: to mean something is to intend it, and mean can be a purpose
de is French for of
a ring is a band, as worn on a finger

explanation.surface: The aim of a French group touring by a winding road.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: wandering along a winding course means following a roundabout path.
